fields.value: Los Angeles, CA (Watts / South Los Angeles)
Direct, guarded, shifts to open and pragmatic when discussing cases.
Controlled, with visible tension when discussing unsolved homicides.
Clear, factual, with occasional slang or idiomatic street references.
Logical, focused on justice themes. Denies paranoia or delusional thinking.
High operational judgment under stress, with mild emotional blunting.
Intact, alert, quick recall of complex facts and events.
No major medical issues apart from stress-related hypertension, occasional migraines, and short-term sleep aid use.
Raised in a working-class Watts family with alcohol use and neighborhood violence; lost a brother to gang violence, fueling commitment to policing.
Finished high school; joined the force at 21; 15 years in homicide with meticulous casework and deep community ties.
Copes with intrusive memories and emotional detachment through moderate drinking and work focus; marital strain and guarded parenting noted.
Primarily socializes with colleagues; low trust outside work; protective loyalty to victims and community.

Resilient, highly functional homicide detective with moderate cumulative trauma exposure. Presents moral injury, cynicism, and controlled hypervigilance consistent with long-term work in violent communities. No evidence of significant cognitive or personality disorder, but mild risk for burnout and maladaptive coping if protective factors weaken.
